snippet.title: SILENT HILL: Townfall | "Home" Composer: Pilotpriest | KONAMI
snippet.description:
We're honored to announce that acclaimed Canadian musician Pilotpriest is the composer for SILENT HILL: Townfall.
Check out the track 'Home' set to visuals of in-game locations of St. Amelia.

SILENT HILL: Townfall 
https://www.konami.com/games/silenthill/townfall/

https://www.konami.com/games/silenthill/
